release_notes: `brokers.kite.ws_ticks` / `brokers.breeze.ws_ticks` in `config.json` now default to **on** for any new or upgrade install (was off). Direct prevention for the 2026-09-07 Breeze incident: with ticks off, every `ltp()` call went straight to the REST `get_option_chain_quotes` endpoint that hit ICICI's `"Limit exceed: API call per day"` for 29+ hours; with ticks on, most `ltp()` calls are served from the local WS tick cache instead. An existing install with an explicit `"ws_ticks": false` is unaffected — this only changes the fallback used when the key is absent. `broker/dhan_adapter.py` / `broker/breeze_adapter.py`: quote throttling (`DhanAdapter._throttle_quote()`, Breeze's per-singles pacing) now goes through a new shared SQLite-backed gate (`broker/_rate_gate.py`) instead of an in-process timestamp. Every strategy runs as its own OS subprocess, each with its own adapter instance — the old throttle only paced calls made by that one process, so several strategies' monitor ticks (plus dashboard polling) landed in the same account-wide rate limit with no shared coordination, the other half of the 2026-09-06/07 Dhan/Breeze rate-limit incident. See `plans/plan-broker-call-throttle-coordination.md`. `charges.py`/`charges_reconcile.py`: real broker charges now used instead of trusting an unsettled Rs-0.
